pay_ready: All checks passed. Ready to pay.
arith_line: A line item does not add up: quantity times rate is not the amount printed.
arith_subtotal: The line items do not add up to the subtotal.
arith_total: Subtotal plus tax does not equal the total printed on the bill.
arith_words: The amount in words does not match the amount in figures.
dup_exact: This bill was already paid or is pending. Only the number or date format changed. No money sent.
dup_fuzzy: This looks very similar to an earlier bill from the same vendor. Please check before paying.
bank_invalid: The bank says this account is not valid. No money sent.
name_mismatch: The name registered at the bank does not match this vendor. No money sent.
account_shared: This bank account is already registered to a different vendor. No money sent.
account_changed: This vendor is asking to be paid into a new bank account. We will confirm with the vendor on their number on file before paying.
callback_mismatch: We called the vendor on their number on file. The account digits they gave do not match this bill. No money sent.
callback_no_answer: We could not confirm the new account with the vendor. Holding this bill.
vendor_unverifiable: We could not verify this vendor's registration. Please confirm before paying.
low_confidence_read: Part of this bill could not be read clearly. Please check the highlighted field.
gstin_format: The GST number looks unusual. Please check it.
ifsc_format: The bank IFSC code looks unusual. Please check it.
date_implausible: The bill date looks wrong. Please check it.
tax_rate: The tax rate on this bill is not a standard GST rate. Please check it.
over_limit: This bill is above your limit for automatic payment. Please confirm.
cash_deferred: This bill is fine, but there is not enough cash in this run. It will be paid in the next run.
approval_invalid: The approval did not match. Nothing was paid. Please try again.
dup_number: This vendor's bill with the same number has already been paid. No money sent.
arith_gst_split: The GST on this bill is split the wrong way for these two states. No money sent.
new_vendor: This vendor is not in your vendor list yet. Please check and add them before paying.
approval_pin: Confirmed. Now enter your PIN to authorise this payment.
approval_second: One approval received. A second person must enter their PIN for this payment.
approval_prompt: {count} bills, total {total} rupees. Say yes, the number of bills, the total, and this code: {code}.
approval_retry: That did not match. Please say yes, the number of bills, the total and the code again.
callback_prompt: Hello, this is {buyer}. We received a bill asking for payment to a new bank account. Please tell us the last four digits of the account you want us to pay.
callback_ok: The vendor confirmed the account ending {last4}.
callback_owner_confirm: {vendor} confirmed the new account ending {last4} on their number on file. Do you approve this account change?
payout_success: Paid {amount} rupees to {vendor}. The bank has confirmed it.
payout_failed: The payment of {amount} rupees to {vendor} failed. No money left your account. It will not be retried without your approval.
payout_reversed: The bank returned the payment of {amount} rupees to {vendor}. The bill is open again. It will not be paid again without fresh checks and your approval.
payout_pending: The payment of {amount} rupees to {vendor} is being processed. We will not send it again.
